name: Com ga
summary: Com ga is chicken with turmeric rice. Da Nang serves two habits side by side: a Hong Kong-style plate and the Hoi An plate, with shredded chicken and a sharper dip.
origin: Hoi An made the central-coast version famous. Da Nang shops cook both that plate and a Hong Kong-style chicken rice on the same streets.
howToEat: Ask which chicken the shop is cooking before you sit. The rice looks similar. The chicken and the dip do not.
Eat the dip with the meat, not as a soup on the side.
Lunch is the hour. A cold plate from the morning is the one to skip.
where: In Hoi An the plate is shredded chicken, turmeric rice, herbs, a bowl of chicken soup, and a sour papaya salad. Eat that plate in Hoi An.
Hồng Ngọc, 193 Nguyễn Chí Thanh, is the Hong Kong-style plate. Tú Tài, 62 Hải Phòng, is the Hoi An-style plate.
priceBand: A shop plate is an everyday lunch.
